decision: Classified Q6 as D1; all other supplied items as D2 using the repository five-component rubric.

decision: Selected sigma/pi orbital allocation without double-counting as hardest learner-relative sub-concept; primary demand REPRESENT.

consequence: Core1A will include a staged orbital-inventory interaction.

decision: Builder change remains UNDECIDED until exact governed HTML is rendered and inspected.

consequence: No speculative renderer/builder edit in first authoring commit.

decision: Materialised canonical records and governed Core1A/Core2 HTML through render_core/2.

decision: Strict quality gate and Playwright tablet audit both exited 0.

decision: Exact-render H1–M3 review completed; P2/M2/M3 are PARTLY for all ten questions, Q6 S1–S3 are NOT_APPLICABLE, remaining asks are YES.
rationale: Core2 protects answers and provides targeted hints/solutions; however concept links stop at microtopic anchors, wrong-route warnings do not diagnose misconception-versus-slip, and repair is indirect.

decision: Recorded OWNER_SUPPLIED authorship-disclosure discrepancy instead of silently relabelling.

consequence: No unsupported exam/owner-authorship claim is added; source-honesty limitation remains open.

decision: Proposed reusable ONE_TO_ONE_ALLOCATION builder interaction after exact page inspection.
rationale: The staged orbital visualization teaches the hardest bridge but cannot require a learner to assign each orbital exactly once to sigma/pi roles; a constrained allocation primitive would test the representation demand without a chemistry-specific renderer.
consequence: No builder code changed in the candidate; proposal is review-only.
